description: Record a durable fact in the shared memory (memory/*.md) as a dated bullet with a stable ^id. If it replaces an earlier fact, pass supersedes (the old fact's ^id, or a distinctive substring of it) — the old fact stays visible with strikethrough and a pointer to the new one. Use search_notes to find existing facts first.

fact.description: The fact, stated so it makes sense without conversation context

supersedes.description: ^id or distinctive substring of the fact this replaces

topic.description: Optional topic — facts go to memory/<topic>.md instead of memory/facts.md

name: remember
title: Remember a fact
